info.title: RSNA Knee: 99.14% Accuracy at 36.36% Coverage
info.subtitle: 11 continuous soft labels; no Synovitis; 58-study development benchmark
info.description:
**99.14% accepted accuracy at 36.36% finding coverage** on the familiar 58-study expert-labeled RSNA knee development subset.

This release provides **continuous soft scores for 11 findings across all 4,407 RSNA training studies. Synovitis is not included.**

## Measured development result

**230 of 232 accepted findings were correct**, out of 638 evaluated findings (58 studies × 11 findings). Coverage counts individual study–finding cells, not complete MRI studies. The 95% Wilson accuracy interval is 96.91%–99.76%.

The same published threshold accepts 40.12% of finding cells in the 4,349 weak studies. That is an acceptance rate; accuracy on the weak pool has not been independently measured.

## What is included

ACL, MCL, Medial Meniscus, Lateral Meniscus, Medial OA, Lateral OA, PF OA, Effusion, Baker's cyst, Contusion and Fracture. **No Synovitis.**

| File | Use |
|---|---|
| soft_labels.csv | All 4,407 study IDs and 11 continuous targets |
| confidence.csv | Estimated correctness used for acceptance |
| accepted_mask.csv | 1 accepted, 0 deferred, for each finding |
| training_weights.csv | Confidence × acceptance for weighted training |
| study_metadata.csv | Expert exclusions, folds and duplicate-report groups |
| quick_start.ipynb / example.py | Runnable loading and training-split examples |
| evaluation.json / transfer_stress_test.json | Exact metrics, per-label counts and uncertainty |
| reproduce_metrics.py | Recompute metrics with your official train.csv |

## Use the soft targets

Join files by **StudyInstanceUID**, preserve it as text, and use **training_weights.csv** for finding-level loss weights. Deferred findings retain their continuous target but receive weight zero. Keep all 58 expert development studies outside student training; the example also keeps exact duplicate-report groups together.

## Evaluation scope

The acceptance threshold and score family were selected from 35 frozen candidate rankings on the same familiar development panel. This is a development-optimized research release, not an independent clinical validation or a hidden leaderboard result. The interval above does not account for all selection effects. Only 21.13% of expert-positive findings are recovered in the accepted subset, so accepted accuracy is not sensitivity.

The transfer stress test observed **79/79 correct at 12.38% finding coverage**. With only 79 accepted findings, its 95% Wilson lower bound is 95.36%; this does not establish 99% population accuracy.

Neither target is certified accuracy across the full RSNA dataset. Exact results, per-finding counts, source history and attribution are retained in the release.

## Provenance and terms

Study IDs and the finding schema come from [RSNA Knee Abnormality Detection](https://www.kaggle.com/competitions/rsna-knee-abnormality-detection). This is a versioned set of derived predictions. No raw reports, MRI images, official answer keys, credentials or pretrained weights are redistributed. The original competition data retain their own terms. New derived labels use CC BY-NC 4.0; original source licences and credits remain in source_provenance.json and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt.

The original [97.13% release](https://www.kaggle.com/datasets/omerzalman/rsna-knee-11-label-evidence-fusion) remains unchanged. These are separate optional variants, not a replacement. No regular update schedule is planned.
